detail.longDescription: The term 'vibe-coding', to some, implies non-seriousness. It implies fickleness. It implies slop. LLM generated code is becoming less sloppy. It is relied upon by serious and real software engineers. I have a proposal for the new terminology. L Code Code generated by an LLM L Coder Someone who codes in natural language via instructions to an LLM. L Coding The act of prompting an LLM to generate code. heLl Code L code that has never been, and will likely never be, checked by someone who knows the language it was written in. Potentially dangerous.
